description: P3 playable-baseline end-to-end automation constants and per-step runner hooks (E1-E8). Every runner ships implemented=false; flip to true only when the backing probe/script is wired for that attempt.

E1.title: LoadGame reaches character selectable/selected
E1.exit_criteria: E1: launching the product reaches the character-select state (character selectable or already selected) without blocking errors.

runner.strategy: boot probe hop over the LoadGame scene, then assert the character-select marker in the captured output/evidence
runner.note: hook reserved: flip implemented=true once the attempt wires the character-select marker assertion on top of the boot probe report

E2.title: Enter TestLevel without blocking errors
E2.exit_criteria: E2: TestLevel loads with zero fatal signatures (crash / failed scene load / SCRIPT ERROR beyond known-benign asset noise).

runner.strategy: smoke probe hop chain restricted to TestLevel; require reached=true and no fatal signature
runner.note: hook reserved: flip implemented=true when the attempt maps smoke-hop results onto this step's verdict

E3.title: Movement + Dash position assertion
E3.exit_criteria: E3: player displacement after move/dash inputs matches the declared delta within tolerance.

runner.strategy: combat harness movement_dash_smoke scenario; candidate/launch wiring supplied by the attempt
runner.note: hook reserved: attempt must append --candidate/--launch (and --telemetry) before flipping implemented=true

E4.title: Active skill release produces combat events
E4.exit_criteria: E4: releasing an active skill yields direct_hit/damage events on the combat event spine.

runner.strategy: combat harness single_melee_hit scenario as the minimal combat-event producer; candidate/launch wiring supplied by the attempt
runner.note: hook reserved: attempt must wire --candidate/--launch and assert spine damage events > 0

E5.title: Kill a mob
E5.exit_criteria: E5: at least one spawned mob reaches death with a kill event attributed to the player.

runner.strategy: combat harness cluster_kill_20 scenario; killed counter >= 1 (full 20 for the strict variant)
runner.note: hook reserved: attempt must wire --candidate/--launch and map telemetry.killed onto this step's verdict

E6.title: Pickup drop lands in inventory
E6.exit_criteria: E6: a dropped item picked up from the ground appears in the character inventory state.

runner.strategy: pending: needs an input-driver probe that walks to a drop, collects it and dumps inventory state (no existing tool covers this yet)
runner.note: hook reserved: attempt supplies the pickup/inventory probe script and its command template here

E7.title: Skill screen and passive tree screen open without crash
E7.exit_criteria: E7: toggling the skill screen and the passive/mutation tree screen in-game produces no fatal signature and both close cleanly.

runner.strategy: pending: needs a UI-toggle probe driving the in-game screens (skill panel + passive tree) and scanning for fatal signatures
runner.note: hook reserved: attempt supplies the UI probe script and its command template here

E8.title: Save -> Load restores key state
E8.exit_criteria: E8: after save then reload, semantic key state (character/orbs/loadouts/stash) survives the round trip.

runner.strategy: s3 persistence gate (save->exit->reload semantic compare); attempt supplies --candidate/--apdata/--seed-save paths
runner.note: hook reserved: attempt fills the s3_persistence_gate invocation (candidate exe, apdata dir, seeded save) into command_template
